name: Stun Grenade
notes: Slows instead of stuns bosses (unless they are immune to slow). deals same damage as level of frag damage and penetration. Effect UI is a large electrical flash, like static field effect, that fills whole frag radius
summary: Turns the Frag Grenade into a Stun Grenade that deals lightning damage and stuns enemies. Has lightning penetration instead of armor penetration. 5 Second Cooldown.
